pageGeneralWithdrawalGuideCoinbase:
1. Sign up on coinbase.com with your email and password, then verify your email.
2. Complete identity verification (KYC): a government ID (passport, ID card or driver’s license) plus a selfie.
3. Go to Assets → the token to receive (USDC, EURC, SOL or cbBTC) → Receive → Solana network to get your deposit address, then save it here with "Add a withdrawal address".
pageGeneralWithdrawalGuideJupiter:
1. Open the Jupiter app → Spend tab (card icon, bottom right) → sign in with your Global ID (email, Google or Apple).
2. Complete identity verification at the Verification Center: ID document, phone number, liveness selfie, personal information and a short questionnaire (a few minutes; up to 3–5 days if flagged for review).
3. Once verified, tap Add Money to reveal your USDC/USDT deposit address, then save it here with "Add a withdrawal address".
4. Enter the referral code below if it was not prefilled during signup.
pageGeneralWithdrawalGuideNexo:
1. Sign up on nexo.com with your email and password, then verify your email.
2. Complete identity verification: personal details first, then an ID document and a selfie (advanced verification is required to deposit).
3. Open Top up → USDC or SOL → Solana network to get your deposit address, then save it here with "Add a withdrawal address".
